welcomeEmail.title: Welcome Email
welcomeEmail.emailTemplate:
Dear ##FIRST_NAME##,

Thank you for signing up for regular giving and joining our community of supporters. Your commitment to our cause is deeply appreciated and makes a significant impact on our mission. Every contribution helps us continue the vital work we do, and with your support, we are empowered to make a lasting difference in the lives of those we serve.

Your generosity not only fuels our ongoing projects but also inspires others to join in our efforts. We promise to keep you informed about how your donations are being used and the progress we’re making toward our shared goals.

Once again, thank you for your dedication and trust. If you have any questions or would like more information about our programs, please feel free to reach out.

With heartfelt thanks,

My important charity
